newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lincoln National cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lincoln National cut.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer & Co analyst Eric Berg said he reduced the rating on Lincoln National Corp to market perform from outperform.
-- said that while he supports the company's longer-term strategy to invest in the money management business, he was concerned about the near-term decision to sell its property casualty business.
-- said that with the decision, the company "will sit on the cash, or make an acquisitions in money management that could be seriously dilutive to shareholders."
-- said "the company is generally managing for the long haul, and that's hurting the share price."
